results.name: TERMINATOR: T-800 Endo-Skeleton (Damaged)
results.description:
**Terminator 800 Series Endo-Skeleton from the T1 movie (at the end)**

This is just my re-designed T-800, with alot of wear and metalic degradation on the edges.

I tried to keep it as low-poly/game-ready as possible, but its harder than I thought; given all the parts and hydraulics.

I chose this animation scene to portray the T-800 not stopping until its target is terminated. Also, its pretty damn terrifying just imagining being chased by it.

If you want to use this model let me know what for in the comments, I'll take a peek at ur work ;)

results.name: Terminator T-800 [SFM]
results.description:
Terminator is an American media franchise created by James Cameron and Gale Anne Hurd. It is considered to be of the cyberpunk subgenre of science fiction.[4][5] The franchise primarily focuses on a post-apocalyptic war between a synthetic intelligence known as Skynet, and a surviving resistance of humans led by John Connor. Skynet uses an arsenal of cyborgs known as Terminators, designed to mimic humans and infiltrate the resistance. A prominent model throughout the films is the T-800, commonly known as the Terminator and portrayed by Arnold Schwarzenegger. Time travel is a common aspect of the franchise, with humans and Terminators often sent back to alter the past and change the outcome of the future.
Ported from: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1932935409

results.name: PMC Wagner T-80BV "Sibir"
results.description:
This T-80BV, with the nickname "Sibir" painted on it, was used by the Wagner mercenary group during their failed 2023 coup against the Russian government in Rostov-on-Don. "Sibir" was photographed numerous times driving through the streets of Rostov during Wagner's capture of the city.
I did my best to reflect every unique modification visible in photographs of this tank in my model. 

![](https://ik.imagekit.io/po8th4g4eqj/prod/tr:w-1168/wagner-rostov-tank-1168x440px.jpg)

**Join the Discord!** https://discord.gg/yFmUkcYb

**THIS MODEL IS NOT INTENDED TO GLORIFY THE WAGNER GROUP OR ITS ACTIONS!** PMC Wagner is designated as a terrorist organization by Ukraine and the United Kingdom, among others. This model does not promote the terrorist actions of Wagner.

This is a modification of the T-80B from War Thunder.

results.description: The Terminator (also known as T-800 and T-850) is a fictional character from the Terminator franchise portrayed by both Arnold Schwarzenegger and numerous actor stand-ins digitally overlaid with Schwarzenegger's likeness. The Terminator itself is part of a series of machines created by Skynet for infiltration-based assassination missions, and while an android for its appearance resembling a human, it is described as a cybernetic organism consisting of living tissue over a robotic endoskeleton.

results.name: Kvalsundskipet
results.description:
Skipet blei funne på garden Kvalsund, i Herøy kommune på Sunnmøre, i 1920. Funnet vert tolka som eit myroffer. Dendrodatering frå 2019 viser at det er eit vikingskip frå 780 – 800 AD.
Kvalsundskipet er derfor yngre enn tidlegare antatt.

Skipet er tolka til å vere 18 m langt og 3,2 m breitt. Det hadde ein hoggen T-kjøl og 20 årar.
Kvalsundskipet er bygd i eik, med furu ripbord. Det har heilvokste band (spant) i furu, utan betar med lause tofter. Banda var truleg festa med kvalbardar i eikeborda, men med trenaglar i ripbordet. På ripa har det vore festa keipar også med trenaglar. Sidestyre med ei kraftig rong (spant) for feste. 

Det vart laga ein replika i 1973, bygd av Sigurd Bjørkedal. Orginalfunnet ligg i Bergen, og kopien står på Sunnmøre Museum.

Forskingsrapport:
https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2352409X19305449?fbclid=IwAR1Ntb4ZcdCNm6jpz5jDQDG_Gs3kZd59WB1Qt89zDPbDh9KtCMCsYZA9Y-M

Created in RealityCapture by Gaute Gunleiksrud from 1312 images in 04h:45m:13s.
